acceptance_criteria.statement: Runtime and agent-pack schema accept and reject one explicitly documented externalRead domain grammar, including IPv4-embedded IPv6.
An executable shared corpus proves runtime/schema agreement for accepted and rejected DNS, IPv4, and IPv6 cases.
Missing fields remain compatible, methods fail closed with controlled PolicyError, and GET is the only permitted method.
Accepted values are canonicalized deterministically and compiled grant arrays and containing objects are defensive immutable copies.
Full Node tests and git whitespace checks pass with changes limited to the three allowed paths.
